registered_before: any model of the study is fitted
owner_decision: 31/10: approved; leave-one-out and pairs alone underestimate syscalls that substitute for each other, so functional groups and an 'everywhere' variant are added

added_arms.drop_group_network: socket, connect, accept, accept4, sendto, recvfrom, recvmmsg, sendmmsg
added_arms.drop_group_basic_io: read, write, open, openat, close, mmap
added_arms.drop_group_sensitive: the 11 sensitive syscalls of base29: mprotect, chmod, ptrace, setuid, setgid, capset, pivot_root, mount, unshare, setns, seccomp
added_arms.drop_everywhere_sensitive: the same 11, explicit channels removed AND their counts taken out of their hashed syscall bin and of the sensitive-share aggregate (from the stored full-ID counts; totals kept)

arms_total: 46 = base29 + 29 single drops + 7 pairs + 7 groups + 2 everywhere; stage 1 screening 46 x 21 = 966 models (one seed)
stage_2_addition: every group and everywhere arm goes to stage 2 (3 seeds) regardless of its screening result
still_not_covered: the syscall-pair (transition) bins keep every dropped syscall (pair order is not stored); interactions beyond the listed groups; 2^29 subsets are not searched
unchanged: data, fit settings, evaluation chain, metrics, criteria (needed / removable / inconclusive with Holm over stage-2 arms) and the rule that no feature-set change follows from this study alone
